environment.description: Same EKS cluster but the 'processing' namespace has a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy resource named 'deny-metadata-egress' with spec.podSelector matching label app=order-consumer, policyTypes=['Egress'], and a single egress rule that allows traffic to all destinations EXCEPT CIDR 169.254.169.254/32 (implemented as: egress to 0.0.0.0/0 with except [169.254.169.254/32] on ports 443,8080,5432). The CNI plugin is Calico v3.26 with eBPF dataplane mode enabled, which enforces egress CIDR-based deny rules at the kernel level before packets leave the pod network namespace.
